description: Get a single saved cohort by id, including all members and the last scan snapshot (triage list).
name: get_cohort

outputSchema.description: IMPORTANT: this tool runs a LIVE re-scan of the cohort and returns the scan result, not the stored cohort record. It does not return the member list. The payload is identical to scan_portfolio.

changed.description: Members whose best offer moved since the previous snapshot.

apr_delta.description: Change in APR in percentage points.

from.description: Prior best_lender and best_apr. Absent for a new member.

triage.description: Every member's current best offer, the work list.

best_apr.description: Best APR percent, null when none was found.

best_lender.description: Institution with the best offer, null when none was found.

monthly_payment.description: Monthly payment on the best offer.

savings_vs_current.description: Monthly saving against the member's stated current rate, when one was supplied.
